# ADR-3111: A10: Link-local address request for probe 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Link-local ranges host cloud metadata services.

## Decision

Egress SHALL NOT allow a link-local address request for probe 3 (A10-3).

## Consequences

Block 169.254.0.0/16 and equivalent IPv6.
